# Legacy Collection & Environment Fixtures

This directory contains frozen, legacy PyPost format v1 collection and environment fixtures.
These files serve as permanent test fixtures to verify backwards compatibility and migration routines
for older PyPost workspaces and export formats.

## Fixtures

- `legacy_jira_mcp_v1.json`: Legacy v1 JSON export format of Jira Cloud MCP collection (without embedded variable definitions).
- `legacy_jira_cloud_env_v1.json`: Legacy v1 environment export array with separate variable definitions and hidden secret keys.
- `legacy_mcp_v1.json`: Legacy v1 local probe MCP collection.
- `legacy_gurushots_v1.json`: Legacy v1 GuruShots API collection.
